# Fashion Look Tailors & Gifting Fabrics

> Bespoke men's tailoring and luxury unstitched fabric gift boxes, with two locations in Navi Mumbai and Mumbai. Home delivery available in Navi Mumbai.

- Pathani Suit with Salwar — ₹1,200-1,350 stitching, 5-7 days
- Executive Safari Suit — ₹1,600-2,200 stitching, 7-10 days
- Custom Tailored Shirt — from ₹550-1,100
- Formal Trouser — from ₹650

## Gift Boxes
